text_block_list.text: While out walking with Meisho Doto, we stop by the shopping district…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? There's quite a crowd here. Sh-should we… make our escape?
There's no need to up and run away. I go and have a look for myself…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! You there, the Umamusume hiding in the back! Care to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's a raffle… But what's inside? Thinking about it makes m-m-m-meee…
It's not like anything bad is in there. We give the raffle a go, using our one ticket.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: So, this is a raffle machine… I'll try not to grip the lever too hard so it doesn't snap and break off.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Don't break. Don't break… Yah!
As she repeats her funny wish, we gently turn the lever!
A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!
You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat?!
No doubt about it. She's blacked out.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I can't possibly accept something like this!
choice_data_list: You don't want to go to the hot springs?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I can't. I can't, I can't, I caaan't. Besides… I have so so many races to run, and…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: How am I supposed to accept something so wonderful?! I'm a walking disaster, always messing things up.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: And, I promise there's a good reason why I really can't go.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I know I'll misplace the ticket if I hold onto it. I could lose it today, even.
…She's not wrong about that. It's very possible she'd lose the ticket before our schedule simmers down.
choice_data_list: Would you like me to keep it safe?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, you… would?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Okay. I know it'll be safe in your hands, unlike in mine.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: So… Um… I'll entrust it to you. Or…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I don't mind if you end up using it, either. It's too much of a luxury for me, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm happy enough just having pulled it.
I can't use this ticket in good faith. I'll save it as a little present for Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!
You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A d-d-d-d-deluxe carrot hamburger steak?! We got an amazing pull!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I could just… I!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Phew… I'm stuffed…
choice_data_list: You haven't even had your first bite?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Well, it's like… I'm satisfied from this wonderful result alone.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it's great to have tried out a raffle with someone. I don't think doing it alone would be this fun.
It sounds like Meisho Doto doesn't have much luck with raffles.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um… would you let me have this hamburger steak after our outing?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh wow… And I get to eat something delicious. This makes me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: How nice… I'm really so glad I could go out together with you, Trainer. ♪
In the end, we split the delicious hamburger steak, sharing a wonderful moment together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!
You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wow… Look, Trainer, there's lots and lots of carrots. ♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: We should be just fine with this many! How reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ummm, I don't mean anything big by it…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: If you have a lot of something, you can always redo things when you mess up.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Although, it's not like I have anything special in mind to use them for.
From the looks of it, Meisho Doto feels more at ease having many things as opposed to one.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, but maybe this is a good opportunity to try something that normally scares me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I could peel them or chop them finely for a salad. ♪
Meisho Doto and I try a number of different ways to prepare the carrots. Afterwards, we enjoy the many dishes we made.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!
You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: One carrot… Ngh, I'm so sorry, Trainer. This is all my fault.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: If I wasn't so clumsy and had just a bit more luck to my name…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: We would have two carrots instead!
That's Meisho Doto, always setting the bar low. However…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Missy, I don't have a prize for two carrots. The prize grade above yours offers much, much more.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wh-what? Much, much more?! Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I don't stand a chance as I am now. Uugh, I'll come try again when I'm ready.
Meisho Doto and I split the carrot in half and nibble on it all the way home.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.
You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Tissues, tough luck… consolation prize…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Phew… I'm disappointed, but kind of relieved at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Well, yes… I must have been feeling this was the best I could do, more or less.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm a little at ease, seeing that things turned out as usual.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But, but… I really shouldn't feel this way, right? This isn't like before my debut.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I have to show my disappointment. Next time… I'll get it next time.
Of course, she shouldn't be indifferent to drawing the shortest straw. Let's take this disappointment in stride.
